en: Fixed the subagent model set in managed settings not applying in Claude Desktop's Code tab; it now overrides your own, as in a terminal, unless those settings also pick a provider or gateway
zh: 修复了在托管设置中设置的 subagent 模型在 Claude Desktop 的 Code 标签页中不生效的问题；现在它会像在终端中一样覆盖你自己的设置，除非这些设置还指定了 provider 或 gateway
